companyDetails.coreProductOrService: Product design brand with a purpose, converting art pieces drawn by individuals with special intellectual disabilities (such as Down Syndrome) into daily lifestyle products like stationery, tableware, black books, apparel, and customized jewelry items.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: When founder Dhrittika was born with Down Syndrome, she underwent massive early physical stress. Her family noted that tickling her feet was the only stimulus she reacted to positively, inspiring her childhood nickname 'Tikal'. Although she could not speak until the age of 5, she found her voice through exploring textures, shapes, and colors from a young age. Her mother Shweta, an architect by profession, began taking her to sites and training her in art fields, later expanding the scope to assist more special-needs creators build entrepreneurship traits via their dedicated 'Art Lab' initiative.
companyDetails.businessModel: B2B corporate gifting, bulk customized distribution setups, and D2C online retail website operations.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Delivered over 10,000 distinct finished products to customers and onboarded more than 8 distinct artists with special needs onto the platform.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. A combined validation of ₹21.3 Lakhs for 14% equity was successfully committed by Anupam Mittal and Aman Gupta, aligning structurally with Down Syndrome awareness day themes (21st March).

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A green clean-tech circular economy business running an app-enabled reverse logistics mechanism to extract Used Cooking Oil (UCO) from food establishments, recycling it entirely into high-efficiency, sulfur-free biodiesel.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: After working for several years in corporate supply chain networks across Dubai, the husband-and-wife duo moved back to Jaipur. While looking for a proper school for their children, they stayed at a temporary local guest house and ended up eating most of their daily meals from nearby street vendors. Their children soon fell severely ill with acute stomach infections and diarrhea. Driven by curiosity regarding local sanitation, Sushil asked a Chole Bhature merchant what he did with over-fried, dark residue oil, learning it was frequently thrown down drains or sold back into unorganized food channels. This motivated them to launch an end-to-end traced collection network to fight health risks and generate bio-energy.
companyDetails.businessModel: App-driven reverse logistics collection models capturing raw oil inputs from commercial kitchens, utilizing a profit-sharing capacity setup with third-party processing plants for refining.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Spread operations to touch over 800 cities across India utilizing 16 major collection hubs, recycling over 75 Lakh liters of toxic cooking oil, and earning early incubation equity backing from Shell India's premier 'Shell E4' program.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Concluded a strategic joint agreement with Ritesh Agarwal and Chirag Nakrani for ₹50 Lakhs against 1% equity plus a 6% advisory share framework, backed further by a ₹50 Lakh credit line debt facility at 9% interest over 3 years.

companyDetails.location: Delhi, India (Originally from Mastgarh, Mathura, UP)
companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A specialized sexual wellness and intimacy snacks lifestyle lineup featuring functional herbal dark chocolates formulated for men, women, couples, and the LGBTQ+ community, alongside connection card games and blindfolds.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Saurabh and Rekha are long-time college sweethearts who graduated from an engineering program (Electronics & Communication and Biotechnology respectively) and initially rolled out a standard healthy snacking firm in 2022. While gathering one-on-one consumer focus feedback, they observed that modern millennial couples were experiencing a significant drop in intimacy due to high anxiety and everyday workplace stress. They turned their attention to ancient wellness formulations historically consumed across royal eras, identifying and testing natural adaptogens like Ashwagandha (to suppress baseline cortisol stress spikes) and female-centric Shatavari, blending them directly into dark chocolate to elevate safe blood circulation and dopamine levels.
companyDetails.businessModel: D2C internet e-commerce brand scaling monthly digital transactions via targeted social media conversion funnels and online marketplace presence.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Dispatched over 120,000 distinct finished chocolates within 9 months of active launch, successfully hitting a monthly operational revenue trajectory of over ₹1 Crore.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks chose not to enter the round over looming regulatory/labeling compliance risks associated with over-the-counter aphrodisiac health claims, combined with steep customer acquisition costs (CAC) inside Meta ad bidding models.

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An innovative fitness nutrition and functional snacking brand crafting high-protein plant-based chips, protein bars, and uniquely flavored high-protein peanut butters (such as White Chocolate, Belgian Chocolate, Mango, and Butterscotch) infused with digestive enzymes to eliminate bloating issues.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Aditya was raised in an active business family (his father moved from Rajasthan to Delhi in 1992, famously launching his first business by mortgaging his mother's jewelry). Battling heavy childhood and college obesity where his weight exceeded 90 kg, Aditya underwent a rigorous personal fitness transformation. Throughout this path, he realized that 3 out of 4 everyday Indians face serious protein deficiencies. To counter the dry, unpalatable, and monotone taste profiles that cause consumers to abandon typical fitness foods, he collaborated extensively with food technologists to blend gourmet flavor routines directly into clean protein matrices.
companyDetails.businessModel: D2C website conversions utilized to drive high basket average order values (60% share), layered alongside quick-commerce and e-commerce marketplaces like Amazon (40% share).
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Served more than 50,000 customers across India over 2.5 years, maintaining high biological protein bioavailability absorption ratings (70%) via single-serving lifestyle sachets.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Concluded an aggressive round with Viraj Bahl and Anupam Mittal, shaking hands on a structure of ₹1 Crore for 17.5% equity to secure extensive mass food distribution mentorship.

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: Aesthetic, machine-manufactured home carpets and area rugs that are 100% hand-washable, stain-impermeable, anti-slip, pet-friendly, and engineered utilizing sustainable recycled PET plastic bottle fibers.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: While Samrit was actively practicing as a corporate lawyer, his life partner Harnaam (an interior designer) brought him along to a massive $5 Billion global carpet export exhibition to identify decor assets for a residential design project. Samrit was deeply shocked to find that hand-knotted luxury carpets easily retailed at steep prices exceeding ₹1 Lakh, posing a massive pricing barrier for young millennial homeowners building out initial properties. Sourcing sustainable PET fabrics, they engineered a flexible rubber latex backing structure that enables owners to completely spot-clean deep ketchup or coffee spills with diluted soap water in under 2 minutes.
companyDetails.businessModel: Digital D2C home decor brand moving from single-product area rugs into a comprehensive soft home furnishings label via e-commerce marketplaces and an upcoming retail catalog.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Furnished over 1,200 individual homes within their first year of launch, recording robust gross profit margins approaching 70% due to asset-light printing processes.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Accepted a joint growth capital offer from Vineeta Singh and Ritesh Agarwal of ₹35 Lakhs for 5% equity, layered alongside an additional 5% annual sales royalty structure that caps out gracefully at 1.5x the invested principal.

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A highly specialized artisanal e-commerce brand creating exquisite handcrafted deity crowns, premium spiritual jewelry, and customized traditional vestments tailored specifically for home shrines and major temple idols.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Having experienced deep personal trauma and life hardships, 65-year-old Champa found solace and absolute resilience through her spiritual devotion to Lord Krishna. Inheriting meticulous craft habits from her mother, she treated deity ornamentation as pure worship, frequently handcrafting makeup setups for prominent historical temples in Vrindavan. In 2017, she initiated digital listings on Amazon, donating all early profits to local charities. When organic demand scaled exponentially, her son Vijay (a veteran mobile gaming producer who led scaled gaming pipelines for EA Sports and Reliance Games) stepped in to code a dedicated Shopify storefront and manage operations.
companyDetails.businessModel: Spiritual artisan marketplace driven 95% by organic traffic, scaling highly profitable item bundle checkouts via Amazon and their dedicated web platform.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Hand-decorated and adorned over 15,000 temple idols globally while directly supporting and enabling economic independence for a localized network of 47 homemaker women artisans.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks were deeply inspired by the mother's pure authenticity and exceptional 30% net margins, but collectively stepped away as the hyper-niche, devotion-driven segment does not fit standard scalable venture capital expansion models.

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A clinically validated, completely tasteless, odorless, and color-neutral micronutrient nutrition powder blend composed of essential vitamins, minerals, fibers, and stable probiotics designed to be seamlessly mixed directly into regular home-cooked staple foods like dal or rice.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Amarpreet spent 15 years as a high-performing category director for chocolates at Cadbury/Mondelez before taking a role as Chief Innovation Officer for Diageo India. As parents, the founders observed that sneaking essential nutrients into children's diets was a daily battlefield, leading to widespread structural micronutrient deficiencies. Sourcing expert food scientists, they spent 15 months engineering an encrypted delivery matrix that masks the metallic taste of vital nutrients, ensuring kids consume balanced diets without changing everyday food flavors or textures.
companyDetails.businessModel: D2C online wellness model layered with e-commerce health marketplaces, expanding into offline retail formats via high-density family subscription models.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Positively impacted over 400 families within their early pilot phases, verifying strong gut health and immunological improvements via accredited clinical research loops.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Accepted a structured offer from Vineeta Singh consisting of ₹50 Lakhs for 1% pure equity plus a ₹50 Lakhs debt component at 10% interest over 3 years, paired with a 0.25% advisory share commitment.

Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Simbic (Symbolic Health Tech / Symbiotic)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: High-quality, affordable, and lightweight bionic and mechanical prosthetic upper-limb configurations, featuring active-grip assistive toolkits ('Creaptor') for specialized physical actions like gymming, swimming, and bike riding, paired alongside their premier articulating 'Titan Arm'.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: In September 2018, at 24 years old, mechanical engineer Rishi met with a major bus accident during a volunteer traveling trip for a non-profit organization, which resulted in his right upper limb being severely crushed and subsequently amputated. Waking up post-rehabilitation, he realized the local market was highly polarized: offering non-functional passive prosthetics or imported bionic hands running upwards of ₹40 to ₹50 Lakhs. He teamed up with his long-time childhood schoolmate Niranjan to meticulously break down and reverse-engineer robotic bionics internally, lowering manufacturing thresholds to bring an advanced functional arm to market at an accessible price of around ₹3 Lakhs.
companyDetails.businessModel: Health-tech medical device supply targeting institutional prosthetic centers, clinical trials pipelines, and direct D2C digital web platform requests.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Built highly sensitive EMG hardware filters that filter alternative current (AC) interference noise down to millivolt levels, reducing device structural weight to under 250 grams with up to 18 hours of continuous daily user stickiness.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Secured an overall match matching their past round valuation: ₹40 Lakhs for 2% equity plus an additional ₹40 Lakhs debt component structuralized at 10% annual interest over 3 years, along with a 1% advisory share setup issued to Namita Thapar.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Excel Cinema (Under No Barriers Foundation)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A specialized content delivery system and companion mobile smartphone application facilitating theatrical accessibility for visually and hearing-impaired moviegoers through synced audio descriptions, closed-captioning loops, and interactive sign-language visual tracks.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: In 2012, while visiting family members in Dubai, Kunal took his father out to watch The Avengers. Due to the rapid dialogue pace and local accents, his father struggled heavily to interpret the film, forcing Kunal to continually translate individual scenes aloud. Struck by the profound exclusion experienced by individuals with sensory impairments, Kunal (an MIT Boston professional alumnus who engineered early Bluetooth tracking mapping frameworks for the Indian Government's Arogya Setu application) resolved to digitize cinema spaces via an audio fingerprinting method similar to Shazam, enabling seamless theater synchronization in 10 seconds without altering the audio experience of nearby patrons.
companyDetails.businessModel: B2B content production services model billing production houses and media distribution giants roughly ₹4 Lakhs per feature film for automated pipeline synthesis.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Scaled logistical integration capability to span over 9,000 active Indian cinema screens, achieved 50,000+ standalone application downloads, and completed accessibility processing for top Bollywood blockbusters like Srikanth using an in-house LLM automated workbench pipeline.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks stepped away due to the highly cyclical nature of the target media volume, high dependency on compliance mandates, structural fragmentation, and parallel operating NGO elements handled by the core team.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - RBG Future Plas (Future Plas)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: Patented, heat-resistant, and water-impermeable biodegradable bioplastics and eco-friendly bio-lubricants synthesized sustainably from agricultural waste (specifically low-grade broken industrial waste rice).
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Founder Pallavi spent over a decade conducting rigorous market trend and strategy forecasting for a prominent multinational petroleum enterprise. Following the implementation of India's national ethanol blending program directives, she was inspired to pursue eco-friendly material alternatives. Partnering directly with Jadavpur University in Kolkata, she initially designed a system to synthesize low-cost ethanol from broken waste rice (sourcing materials at just ₹20/kg compared to typical corn starch raw bases at ₹150/kg). Throughout these chemical engineering trials, she accidentally discovered a resilient bioplastic compound variant that perfectly resists standard melting thresholds.
companyDetails.businessModel: Industrial manufacturing and B2B material supply, focusing primarily on tertiary logistics packing sheets, with a long-term strategy centered around international technology licensing.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Secured fully granted utility patents in India and the United States, alongside active PCT cross-filings across 140 nations; executed testing validation NDAs with major industrial giants like Maruti Suzuki, Berger Paints, and Tata Steel.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. A historic combined all-Shark framework was finalized, allocating ₹1 Crore for 5% equity (split equally at ₹25 Lakhs for 1.25% equity each from Aman Gupta, Namita Thapar, Ritesh Agarwal, and Chirag Nakrani).

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Rescript (Under Banpai Firm)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A sustainable stationery brand creating 100% recycled paper notebooks, school journals, and chlorine-free natural off-white office A4 copier sheets manufactured entirely out of processed commercial paper waste.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Ashutosh and Narendra are close childhood schoolmates who graduated from Christ University and completed an executive management program at IIM Bangalore. In October 2019, while sharing coffee, they resolved to start an eco-friendly brand. They noticed massive print waste generated across corporate parks, medical institutions, and schools daily and decided to construct a sustainable paper loop. In their early bootstrapping days, they personally packed their first test order of 6,000 specialty plantable seed pencils into a personal travel suitcase to execute delivery to an early corporate gifting client.
companyDetails.businessModel: Omnichannel sustainable supply network driven 90% by high-volume corporate B2B contracts and 10% via their D2C digital marketplace storefront.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Recycled more than 500 tonnes of commercial paper waste streams, saving an estimated 9,000 trees; successfully locked long-term supply relationships with institutional giants like ICICI Bank, PNB, LIC Housing Finance, and the Lodha School system.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks opted out of the investment round due to thin entry barriers, ease of manufacturing replication, high price competition, and the intense seasonal cyclicality of academic supply purchase timelines.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Subculture

companyDetails.location: Jaipur, Rajasthan / Goa, India (Originally from Arrah, Bihar)
companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An alternative, bold lifestyle fashion and leather craftsmanship label creating tailored body harnesses, structured models, statement collars, and edgy lifestyle accoutrements that celebrate absolute subcultures and individualism.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Raised within a conservative Indian Army family environment, Randhir moved out to Jaipur following his design graduation from NIFT New Delhi to take a senior visual design campus placement. Heavily inspired by Berlin's radical fashion expressionism and underground subculture spaces (like Berghain), he noticed an absolute absence of premium artisanal harness labels across India. He boldly set out to create an alternative market by personally visiting a village outside Jaipur and teaching traditional leather artisans how to adapt their old-school handicraft techniques into manufacturing high-fashion structural leather harnesses and bralettes.
companyDetails.businessModel: Premium niche D2C online fashion storefront, supported by curated underground event productions ('Subculture Experience') across metropolitan centers like Mumbai, Delhi, and Goa.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Constructed an organic and supportive creative fashion ecosystem directly empowering the queer community and non-conformist alternative groups across India.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks highly commended his flawless presentation style and creative drive, but strongly recommended remaining organically self-funded to safeguard the independent, edgy identity of the label from standard venture capital scale filters.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Mountain Whiskey (The Woodsman)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A new-age, light-bodied, premium Indian blended whiskey manufactured specifically utilizing authentic pure Himalayan mountain spring water to deliver an extra-smooth palate experience.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Shivam completed his Masters in Finance and Business Economics from Manchester Business School in 2013. While traveling globally, he recognized that the dominant Indian-Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) landscape was heavily cluttered with legacy labels that felt dated (mostly launched in the 1980s or 90s) and lacked a clean geographical identity. After executing a comprehensive testing pilot project across Goa and Daman under an early label to unpack distributor logistics, he set up operations in the valleys of Solan to leverage pure mountain spring water (which makes up 60% of whiskey volume) to eliminate harsh throat burn for mass-premium consumers.
companyDetails.businessModel: State-regulated IMFL distribution network scaling volume via brick-and-mortar retail wine merchants and wholesale channels across multiple northern states.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Built structured distribution spanning over 1,000 retail endpoints, logging an aggregate gross sales run rate of over ₹120 Crores across their operational lifetime.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Shivam leveraged the national stage primarily for brand awareness and strategic visibility, holding firm onto a premium market valuation threshold of ₹250 Crores, which did not align with early-stage Shark parameter sets.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - The Bear House

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An online-first premium menswear casual fashion powerhouse delivering European minimalist design traits across signature lightweight summer flannels, structured premium polos, streetwear basics, and curated lifestyle caps.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: In 2014, Harsh established a scaled garment factory manufacturing setup that exported high-volume premium apparel lines for premier global fast-fashion labels like Zara, Mango, Pull&Bear, and Marks & Spencer. However, a later expansion into the domestic unorganized retail sector piled up deep losses, forcing a complete factory closure in 2019 that left the team with ₹18 Crores in debt and a warehouse full of premium fabric stock. Partnering with his wife Tanvi (a communication graduate who completed an advanced clothing technology specialization course at NIFT), they engineered an agile design framework to cut out supply chain middlemen and pass premium fabric grades directly to Indian buyers at mass-premium pricing.
companyDetails.businessModel: Scaled digital-first D2C fashion model driven heavily by marketplace integrations (Myntra, Flipkart, Ajio), currently initiating brick-and-mortar retail expansion via physical Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs).
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Successfully fulfilled apparel requirements for over 20 Lakh individual fashion consumers with an exceptional 65% organic repeat purchase cohort, driving current annualized revenue trends (ARR) to touch roughly ₹150 Crores with robust double-digit profitability metrics.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Finalized a major growth capital investment from Namita Thapar consisting of ₹2 Crores debt at 10% interest over 5 years, paired with ₹1 Crore for 1% pure equity.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Urban Animal

companyDetails.location: India (Founders met at University of Warwick, UK)
companyDetails.coreProductOrService: Advanced, non-invasive canine genetic mapping and DNA diagnostic saliva kits ('Trace' and 'Map') scanning for 134 inherited conditions and physical traits to provide veterinarians and pet parents customized prevention blueprints.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: While completing their undergraduate studies together at the University of Warwick in the United Kingdom, Akash and Arunava became inseparable friends. Years later, their beloved pet dog, Milo, began experiencing severe, unprovoked hind-limb limping that was subsequently diagnosed as a permanent genetic arthritic condition. Distressed by the revelation that 3 out of 4 dogs harbor latent, fatal hereditary conditions that present symptoms only when too late for effective management, they engineered a safe saliva-swab diagnostic framework to allow proactive pet mapping to safely extend a dog's life span by up to 3 years.
companyDetails.businessModel: Pet-tech digital e-commerce model utilizing specialized pricing anchoring setups, using veterinarian clinics as a core go-to-market (GTM) lead source.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Successfully mapped and cataloged detailed genetic markers for over 800 individual dogs across various breeds in the Indian market with 99.1% testing accuracy.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks backed away from the round because the domestic pet genetic diagnostics space remains at an extremely nascent consumer adoption stage, requiring steep educational customer acquisition burns relative to lower monthly recurring transactional flows.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Style Story (Style Stroy)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An ultra-affordable hyper-fast-fashion women's footwear label leveraging high-volume bulk flash bundling combo deals (e.g., 2 pairs for ₹999 or 3 pairs for ₹1299) to capture budget apparel markets.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Born into a traditional merchant family, the brothers adhered to their father's strict advice to master retail fundamentals from the ground up, working as entry-level floor salesmen inside a crowded footwear bazaar during their school breaks. Sudit recognized the insatiable appetite of young consumers for international runway shoe aesthetics and coded a basic WordPress site. To completely eliminate dead inventory write-offs, they established a crowd-sourced design selection workflow where all final production run models are voted on and curated by their social media followers through interactive Instagram stories before contract factory manufacturing initiates.
companyDetails.businessModel: High-velocity D2C fast-fashion digital brand dependent entirely on high average order value (AOV) combo item checkouts to maintain unit profitability.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Successfully fulfilled and dispatched over 5.5 Lakh pairs of women's footwear to consumer endpoints across pan-India delivery routes.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks backed away due to flat revenue trajectories across the preceding three fiscal years, combined with an incredibly high 43% Return-To-Origin (RTO) and cancellation rate, primarily driven by long transit times into the North East cluster.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Quit (Quiet Sea Products)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A holistic, zero-nicotine behavioral smoking cessation ecosystem featuring 'Flow'—a non-electronic, battery-free aromatherapy breathing stick designed to mimic the physical hand-to-mouth habit loops of smoking—paired alongside nutrient-rich withdrawal management gummies.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Having successfully maintained a smoke-free life for over 6 years, founder Jeevan knew firsthand that breaking a nicotine addiction is as much a deep psychological and social sensory battle as it is a chemical dependence. He teamed up with his long-time childhood best friend Dr. Vinod (an MBBS medical graduate) to design a safe placebo loop that addresses localized situational triggers (such as smoking over morning coffee or with corporate friends) by deploying calming essential plant oils combined with zero-sugar nutraceutical gummies containing Melatonin, Magnesium, and L-Theanine to balance neurological pathways.
companyDetails.businessModel: Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) wellness brand scaling via automated monthly digital subscriptions, utilizing a razor-and-blades monetization framework centered on flavor pod replacements.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Fulfilling over 5,000 active smoker quit kits within their early operational months, driving a monthly validation velocity of around ₹33 Lakhs.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks exited the round collectively due to a critical absence of extensive long-term clinical trials, metabolic bio-availability metrics, and independent medical data verifying the absolute efficacy of the compound blends against heavy nicotine cravings.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Super Bolter

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A cloud-based, hyper-fast interactive 3D spatial design software platform that empowers everyday residential property buyers to completely digitize, layout, and render fully furnished home interiors in under 3 minutes.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Arvind (an alumnus of RV College of Engineering with further business training at UC Berkeley) previously conceptualized and directed an execution-heavy interior design contracting firm named Foldo from 2015 to 2017. Interacting with over 2,000 homeowners, he realized the legacy interior design framework was plagued by long layout delays and massive consumer trust deficits. Resolving to democratize architectural planning for middle-income apartment buyers with strict budgets (₹4 to ₹8 Lakhs), he spent over five years writing a custom web-rendering engine preloaded with 30,000 real-world vendor furniture product assets.
companyDetails.businessModel: Freemium prop-tech software SaaS model targeting end-consumers, layered with an upcoming transaction marketplace to capture vendor supplier product commissions.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Digitized and modeled an active database of over 10,000 real estate floor plans across major Indian apartment blocks, scaling daily platform design traffic to touch 300 active users.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks backed out of the investment due to a flat five-year pre-revenue framework, steep product-use friction that required tutorial loops, and a clear absence of an established commercial monetization proof-of-concept.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - High School Sales Fellowship

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An intensive, practical 4-month hybrid upskilling fellowship training program specifically engineered around outbound B2B technology sales develop workflows, tech stack mastery, and practical prospecting playbooks.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Nikhil faced serious personal job placement hardships during his undergraduate BBA years, quickly realizing traditional business curricula focused heavily on abstract, outdated theories while completely missing cold outreach reality. After working across key operational roles at upskilling platforms like Craftshala, he launched a practical sales program. Simar joined as an entry-level intern and was rapidly elevated to a co-founder share after managing intensive workspace sprints where student groups construct comprehensive corporate playbooks to execute live tech sales.
companyDetails.businessModel: Educational upskilling model charging tuition fees for targeted cohorts, utilizing a strict performance filter (85% attendance and mandatory playbook completions) before opening corporate placement pipelines.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Secured 100% placement execution across early test cohorts, landing graduates high-paying sales development jobs with average compensation packages around ₹15 Lakhs.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks opted out of the round due to very early operational testing windows, urging the young founding group to build an organic, hyper-intensive offline execution blueprint rather than pursuing venture scaling capital premature to structural validation.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Tint Box (Think Inside the Box)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A premium, design-forward consumer lifestyle kitchenware brand creating break-resistant borosilicate glass tiffin containers, travel food boxes, and thermal coffee cups wrapped in thick protective anti-slip colorful silicone insulation sleeves.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Riddhi was a top engineering university graduate who walked away from a comfortable corporate tech job at TCS to pursue a passion for functional industrial design. Back home, her corporate husband suffered from clumsy 'butter fingers', managing to drop and break five standard glass tiffins within three months. Frustrated by plastic chemical leaching risks and the dated look of stainless steel, she partnered with her father Vinay to wrap premium borosilicate glass in a safe, microwave-friendly protective colorful sleeve for workplace professionals.
companyDetails.businessModel: Online-first consumer goods D2C brand distributing via their digital storefront, e-commerce platforms, and select lifestyle boutique retail footprints.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Acquired a happy consumer base of over 1 Lakh users across India, supported by an asset-light operational framework with healthy gross margins.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks declined to invest due to flatlined historical revenue trends (remaining stagnant at ~₹2 Crores for three consecutive financial years) combined with heavy performance-marketing ad budget dependency, indicating a lack of true viral product-market fit.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Tiles Craft (Titcraft)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: An asset-light digital sourcing marketplace, interactive design visualization platform, and streamlined on-demand sampling network connecting residential architects and builders with bulk ceramic tile manufacturers.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Vidya is a proud third-generation ceramic entrepreneur from Morbi, India's premier global tile manufacturing capital. Following her MBA marketing graduation, she worked as a senior accounts manager handling modern retail streams. Returning home during pandemic shutdowns, her industrial father challenged her to learn the unorganized field. Noticing an complete absence of women founders across Morbi's 800+ factories and recognizing that physical showrooms offered highly restricted catalog profiles, she engineered a custom WhatsApp-led digital consulting and heavy-duty sample slicing network to wipe out regional tile breakage risks for interior designers.
companyDetails.businessModel: Asset-light B2B marketplace capturing processing margins on commercial sample logistics and high-volume trade procurement fulfillment.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Built structured sourcing partnerships across 65 major Morbi tile manufacturers, achieving a profitable lifecycle run rate of ₹58 Lakhs in their early test years.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks pulled out over the intensely complex, fragmented downstream installation logistics and the founder's multi-layered model involving legacy localized middlemen distributors.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Bore Charger (Urdhavam Environmental Technologies)

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A globally patented robotic hydrogeological intervention technology and down-hole camera diagnostic system engineered to perform specialized 'borewell angiography' followed by precision perforation to harvest filtered upper-layer rainwater into deep depleted underground aquifers.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Rahul returned to India after a successful software IT career in the United States to commit himself to water conservation, eventually serving as a Grants Director at the Arghyam Foundation. Recognizing that 80% of India's population is heavily dependent on rapidly crashing groundwater tables, he sought a scientific fix to save dry agricultural land. He joined forces with Vineet, a hydrogeologist who completed specialized postgraduate training at the University of Tübingen in Germany. Together, they engineered a custom robotic tool that descends hundreds of feet into failing borewells, cuts precise slits through impervious outer casing pipes, and opens hydrogeological 'angioplasty' blocks to maximize seasonal rainwater replenishment.
companyDetails.businessModel: B2B environmental engineering services contracting model expanding via specialized regional franchise operators who acquire custom machinery.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Successfully recharged and brought back to life over 4,000 borewells across India and drought-prone clusters in Africa, saving an estimated 500 Crore liters of water; officially whitelisted inside the Indian Government's Smart City infrastructure frameworks.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. The founders boldly declined a final sole investment offer from Ritesh Agarwal of ₹75 Lakhs for 10% equity to preserve their baseline corporate valuation guidelines and maintain capital structure integrity.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Art Buzz Hostels

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: Art-centric, design-forward lifestyle youth hostels featuring interactive shared community bunk domains, premium private travel rooms, fully operational remote working spaces, and in-house social lifestyle cafés.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Anubha, a resilient single mother, completed an academic background in Art History and logged extensive financial oversight experience acting as a corporate CFO. Seeking an independent path in 2021, she connected on Instagram with Shashank, an international event producer who fell in love with backpacking shared stay cultures during a solo travel trip through Thailand. Merging their design and real estate talents, they set out to establish a home-grown hostel brand where every single room showcases original local watercolors and visual canvas installations.
companyDetails.businessModel: Leased real estate hospitality model monetizing overnight stays, café food checkouts, and dedicated monthly hot-desk co-working subscriptions.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Expanded footprint to cover 8 major travel junctions across India, delivering a capacity of over 228 active bed spots backed by high 8.5+ ratings on booking platforms.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks backed out due to real estate capital capex overheads, ongoing operational scaling burns, and unanchored metrics regarding the specific target customer profile split across families and solo Gen Z travelers.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Tulua Spices

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A premium clean-label regional spice venture sourcing single-origin raw items (such as high-curcumin Lakadong turmeric and rich Guntur chili powders) completely free of chemical stabilizers, binders, or artificial color enhancements.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: Richie launched her own digital media and marketing agency in 2015, working closely with upcoming Indian culinary labels. Noticing that modern millennial women lacked the time or knowledge to replicate complex heritage heritage bases, she launched a line of ready-to-cook curry bases in 2020. When baseline home patterns shifted post-pandemic, she executed a pivot to concentrate purely on single-origin spice powders. She poached her father Hitesh, who brought 35 years of high-volume sales experience across the commercial HORECA (Hotel, Restaurant, Café) sector, to systematically bypass unorganized market layers.
companyDetails.businessModel: Omnichannel trade model driven 92% by bulk B2B commercial restaurant contracts and 8% through direct consumer web platform purchases.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Built an annualized operational run rate approaching ₹6 Crores, securing stable wholesale relationships with over 100 premium restaurant kitchens.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: No Deal. Sharks stepped out of the round due to a severe division of focus between low-margin bulk industrial B2B accounts and high-CAC consumer-facing digital D2C channels.

videos.title: Shark Tank India Season 4 Segment - Fitelo

companyDetails.coreProductOrService: A digital subscription-driven weight management, specialized lifestyle optimization, and behavioral health app connecting users with personalized nutrition charts, active habits tracking, and live group fitness modules.
companyDetails.storyBehindBrand: The founders met inside a local gym back in 2003 when both were fighting severe, isolating childhood obesity, with their body weights passing 100 kg. Experiencing years of emotional fatigue over restrictive crash diets that inevitably led to rebound weight gain, they realized weight loss is a mental and emotional battle rather than just a physical calculator. Mac completed credentials to become a professional clinical dietician while Sahil mastered behavioral psychology, leading them to design an app ecosystem built around long-term custom accountability lines.
companyDetails.businessModel: Premium subscription monetization model offering tiered weight-management coaching intervals spanning 3 to 12 months.
companyDetails.keyAchievements: Successfully managed health transformations for over 2 Lakh consumers worldwide, directing a full-time clinical team of 800+ nutritionists and mind coaches to scale annualized run rates (ARR) to over ₹91 Crores.
companyDetails.sharkTankDealStatus: Deal Secured. Shook hands on a combined growth capital commitment with Vineeta Singh and Aman Gupta for ₹1.5 Crores against 1% pure equity, paired alongside a temporary 1% sales royalty structure active until the principal is completely recovered.
